title: Poor Customer Service
text:
WARNING: THINK TWICE BEFORE SUBSCRIBING TO KNOWT.

I was charged $119 on September 10 for a subscription I never intended to renew. I’m only 14 years old, and I genuinely did not mean to spend that much money on a subscription I no longer wanted. I explained my situation and asked for a refund, but they still refused to return my money.

I’m extremely disappointed that even after explaining that I’m a student who never intended to make this purchase, my request was denied. This experience has completely damaged my trust in Knowt.

BE CAREFUL BEFORE SUBSCRIBING. Make sure you understand the renewal terms, because forgetting to cancel could cost you $119. I regret subscribing and would warn other students to think twice before paying for this service.

text: So I’ve been seeing this on social media and decided to test it out but I do not really see how this app could be a good way to study for AP exams. me and my other peers view these AP “studying” apps as not really useful. With the heavy use of ai for and AP class, it can’t be really trusted, for example I tried using this app in order to help me with my AP U.S. History class, but all the documents and images are just ai generated giving a lackluster experience in this app, it can’t really replace the amount of good studying you can get from trusted sources like Helmers History or Khan Academy, and also a AP U.S. history teacher on social media has gone ahead and review this app and finds this really horrible. But this app has a lot of potential to help AP students learn on the go, since every student has a phone, they can have this one mobile app and learn in the go. The only problem is that some of the nice features or the full experience of the app can be found by paying for a subscription which is really bad since AP students are high school students, and what do all high school students have in common?
